# ChipForge song format reference

The song file is YAML. `QUICKREF.md` is the short version; this page lists every field.

## Top level

| field | type | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `chipforge` | int | **required** | Format version. Must be 1. One of: `1`. |
| `title` | str | **required** | Track title. Example: `Furnace Heart`. |
| `cue` | str | **required** | Cue type; sets loudness and length defaults (see CUE_GUIDE.md). One of: `boss`, `combat`, `overworld`, `dungeon`, `ambience`, `menu`, `shop`, `victory`, `death`, `gameover`, `credits`, `custom`. |
| `tempo` | num | **required** | Beats per minute. Range 20..400. |
| `time` | str | `4/4` | Time signature. Example: `4/4`. |
| `key` | str | `C` | Key: note + m for minor, or a scale name (used by harmony generator and analysis). Example: `Em, Bb, E phrygian`. |
| `chip` | str | `nes` | Chip profile. One of: `nes`, `gameboy`, `sid`, `fm`, `gm`. |
| `mode` | str | `enhanced` | authentic = hardware-faithful mono; enhanced = stereo, reverb, extra voices. One of: `authentic`, `enhanced`. |
| `seed` | int | `0` | Random seed for noise, ambience and reverb; same seed = identical render. |
| `loudness` | num |  | Target integrated loudness in LUFS. Default comes from the cue type. Range -40..0. |
| `loop` | bool \| map | `True` | true = whole arrangement loops; false = one-shot with natural tail; {from: SECTION} = sections before SECTION are a non-looping intro. Example: `{from: A}`. |
| `swing` | num | `0.0` | Swing amount for off-beat 16ths, 0-0.5. Range 0..0.5. |
| `sr` | int | `44100` | Sample rate. One of: `22050`, `44100`, `48000`. |
| `ambience` | map |  | Environment bed rendered as a separate stem: {bed: factory, level: -19}. |
| `mix` | map |  | Mix/master overrides: {drive, low_drive, hp, echo: {time, taps}, reverb: {size, decay, tone, predelay}}. |
| `channels` | map | **required** | Named channels: name -> {preset, vol, pan, layer, ...}. |
| `patterns` | map | **required** | Named patterns: name -> {bars, chords, <channel>: MML \| generator \| lanes}. |
| `arrangement` | list | **required** | Ordered pattern uses: names or {use, transpose, vol, layers, mute, as}. |

### `mix` (optional master overrides)

| field | type | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `drive` | num | `1.2` | Master soft-clip drive (1 = gentle, 2 = crunchy). Range 0.5..4. |
| `low_drive` | num | `1.5` | Low bus tanh glue drive; adds harmonics so bass reads on small speakers. Range 0..4. |
| `hp` | num | `24` | Master high-pass Hz. Range 10..120. |
| `echo` | map |  | Echo: {time: steps between taps (default 3 = dotted eighth), taps: [gains...]}. |
| `reverb` | map |  | Reverb: {size: seconds, decay: seconds, tone: low-pass Hz, predelay: seconds}. |
| `sidechain` | num | `0.07` | Kick sidechain release in seconds. Range 0.01..1. |
| `hf` | num | `0.95` | Master high-shelf gain above 2.5 kHz (0.95 = highs 5% quieter). Range 0.5..1.5. |
| `hf_freq` | num | `2500` | High-shelf corner frequency in Hz. Range 500..12000. |
| `ceiling` | num | `-1.0` | True-peak ceiling in dBTP for the limiter. Range -12..0. |
| `normalize` | bool | `True` | Normalize to the loudness target (false = only the soft clip and ceiling). |

## Channels (`channels: {name: {...}}`)

Channel names are lowercase identifiers and are referenced by patterns.

| field | type | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `preset` | str | **required** | Instrument preset name (see PRESETS.md). Example: `lead.pulse25`. |
| `vol` | num | `1.0` | Channel gain multiplier. Range 0..4. |
| `pan` | num | `0.0` | Stereo position -1 (left) .. 1 (right). Ignored in authentic mode. Range -1..1. |
| `layer` | int | `1` | Adaptive-intensity layer; 1 always plays, higher layers are separate stems. Range 1..8. |
| `echo` | num |  | Echo send 0-2 (overrides preset). Range 0..2. |
| `reverb` | num |  | Reverb wet level relative to dry, 0-2 (overrides preset). Range 0..2. |
| `duck` | num |  | Kick sidechain depth 0-1 (overrides preset). Range 0..1. |
| `lp` | num |  | Low-pass cutoff in Hz (overrides preset). Range 20..20000. |
| `hp` | num |  | High-pass cutoff in Hz (overrides preset). Range 10..20000. |
| `transpose` | int | `0` | Semitone transpose for the whole channel. Range -48..48. |
| `octave` | int |  | Default MML octave for this channel. Range 0..8. |
| `gm` | int |  | General MIDI program for MIDI export (overrides preset). Range 0..127. |
| `osc` | str |  | Oscillator quality: naive (aliasing, hardware-like) or clean (band-limited). Default from chip/mode. One of: `naive`, `clean`. |

## Patterns (`patterns: {name: {...}}`)

Besides these fields, a pattern has one entry per channel it uses: an MML string or a generator mapping for melodic channels, drum lanes / an events list for kit channels.

| field | type | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bars` | int | **required** | Length in bars. Range 1..256. |
| `chords` | str |  | Chord per bar separated by '\|'; several chords in one bar split it evenly. Example: `Em \| C \| Am B7`. |
| `step` | int | `16` | Grid resolution for drum lanes and generators (16 = sixteenth notes). One of: `4`, `8`, `12`, `16`, `24`, `32`. |
| `exits` | list |  | Bars (1-based, bar *ends*) where an adaptive transition may jump out. Example: `[4, 8]`. |
| `octave` | int |  | Default MML octave for this pattern. Range 0..8. |

### Chord symbols

`chords:` lists one bar per `|`; several symbols inside a bar split it evenly. Root `A`-`G` with `#`/`b`, then a quality, optionally `/bass`. Qualities: `+`, `-`, `5`, `6`, `7`, `9`, `M`, `M7`, `add9`, `aug`, `dim`, `dim7`, `m`, `m6`, `m7`, `m7b5`, `m9`, `madd9`, `maj`, `maj7`, `min`, `o`, `sus`, `sus2`, `sus4`.

### Scales (for `key:` and `harmony.scale`)

`major`, `minor`, `harmonic_minor`, `melodic_minor`, `dorian`, `phrygian`, `phrygian_dominant`, `neapolitan_minor`, `lydian`, `mixolydian`, `locrian`, `pentatonic_major`, `pentatonic_minor`, `blues`, `whole_tone`, `chromatic`

## MML

```text
  c d e f g a b     notes;  '+'/'#' sharp, '-' flat;  optional length (4 = quarter), dots, '&' tie
  r                 rest (same length syntax)
  o4  < >           octave set / down / up          l8   default length
  v12               volume 0-15                     q6   gate 1-8 (8 = legato)
  ~c4               slide (portamento) into this note from the previous one
  [ ... ]3          repeat block
  |                 bar line (ignored)
  @name(args)       macro: @d(0.25) duty, @vib(depth,rate,delay), @arp(0,4,7), @sweep(semis,secs), @env(name)
```

Lengths are note values (4 = quarter, 8 = eighth). A string that divides the pattern length evenly repeats; a longer string is an error.

## Drum lanes

`{k: 'x...x...', s: '....x...'}` - one string per kit piece, one character per grid step (`step:` field, default 16ths). `.` rest, `x` 1.0, `o` 0.55, `g` 0.3, digits `1`-`9` = velocity tenths, `|` ignored. Lanes repeat if they divide the pattern evenly.

### Events (`events: [...]` inside a kit lane mapping, or a bare list)

| field | type | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `at` | str \| num | **required** | Position: 'bar:step' (1-based) or a 0-based step number. Example: `'3:9'`. |
| `hit` | str |  | Kit piece to trigger (a lane letter or a named hit like groan). Example: `crash`. |
| `roll` | str |  | Lane letter to roll (repeated hits with a velocity ramp). Example: `s`. |
| `len` | num |  | Roll length in grid steps, or hit duration in steps for sustained hits. Range 0... |
| `every` | int | `1` | Roll: steps between hits. Range 1... |
| `ramp` | list | `[0.3, 1.0]` | Roll velocity [start, end]. |
| `vel` | num | `1.0` | Velocity 0-1. Range 0..2. |
| `note` | num |  | Pitch (MIDI) for pitched hits. Range 0..127. |
| `from` | num |  | Start pitch (MIDI) for sweeps such as groan or siren. Range 0..127. |
| `to` | num |  | End pitch (MIDI) for sweeps. Range 0..127. |
| `dur` | num |  | Duration in seconds for sweeps/hits with a free length. Range 0... |
| `up` | bool | `False` | Sweep direction for hiss-type hits. |

## Generators (`{gen: name, ...}` on a melodic channel)

### `riff`

| field | type | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `steps` | str | **required** | Semitone offsets from the chord root per step, '.' = rest, 'o:len' = held note. Example: `0 0 12 0 0 12 0 0 \| 0:3 0:3 12:2 0:3 1:3 0:2`. |
| `octave` | int | `2` | Root octave. Range 0..7. |
| `low` | str |  | Instead of octave: keep roots in the octave starting at this note, e.g. e2. Example: `e2`. |
| `gate` | num | `0.85` | Note length as a fraction of its step(s). Range 0.05..1. |
| `follow` | str | `root` | root (default) or bass (use the slash-chord bass note). One of: `root`, `bass`. |
| `duty` | num |  | Pulse width override for pulse voices. Range 0.05..0.95. |

### `arp`

| field | type | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tones` | list | `[0, 1, 2, 3]` | Chord-tone indexes to cycle (3 = root an octave up on a triad). |
| `rate` | int | `1` | Frames (1/60 s) per arpeggio step; 1 = classic fast arp. Range 1..16. |
| `every` | int | `2` | Retrigger a new arp note every N grid steps. Range 1..64. |
| `octave` | int | `4` | Base octave. Range 0..7. |
| `low` | str |  | Instead of octave: keep chord roots in the octave starting at this note, e.g. e4. Example: `e4`. |
| `gate` | num | `0.9` | Note length fraction. Range 0.05..1. |
| `duty` | num |  | Pulse width override for pulse voices. Range 0.05..0.95. |

### `harmony`

| field | type | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `of` | str | **required** | Channel whose notes to harmonize. Example: `lead`. |
| `interval` | int | `-2` | Scale steps to move; -2 = a diatonic third below. Range -14..14. |
| `scale` | str |  | Scale to harmonize in (default: song key). One of: `major`, `minor`, `harmonic_minor`, `melodic_minor`, `dorian`, `phrygian`, `phrygian_dominant`, `neapolitan_minor`, `lydian`, `mixolydian`, `locrian`, `pentatonic_major`, `pentatonic_minor`, `blues`, `whole_tone`, `chromatic`. |
| `vel` | num | `0.8` | Velocity multiplier. Range 0..2. |

### `pad`

| field | type | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `voicing` | list | `[0, 1, 2]` | Chord-tone indexes to hold. |
| `octave` | int | `4` | Base octave. Range 0..7. |
| `low` | str |  | Instead of octave: keep chord roots in the octave starting at this note. Example: `c4`. |
| `gate` | num | `0.98` | Note length fraction of each chord span. Range 0.05..1. |
| `duty` | num |  | Pulse width override for pulse voices. Range 0.05..0.95. |

### `drone`

| field | type | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `octave` | int | `2` | Root octave. Range 0..7. |
| `low` | str |  | Instead of octave: keep roots in the octave starting at this note. Example: `e2`. |
| `fifth` | bool | `False` | Add the fifth above. |
| `merge` | bool | `True` | Merge consecutive identical chords into one long note. |

### `root`

| field | type | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `octave` | int | `1` | Root octave. Range 0..7. |
| `low` | str |  | Instead of octave: keep roots in the octave starting at this note. Example: `e1`. |
| `retrig` | list | `[0]` | Grid steps within each bar where the note restarts. |
| `gate` | num | `0.97` | Note length fraction. Range 0.05..1. |
| `follow` | str | `root` | root or bass. One of: `root`, `bass`. |

## Arrangement items

A pattern name, or a mapping:

| field | type | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `use` | str | **required** | Pattern name. |
| `as` | str |  | Section label for markers and loop points (default: pattern name). |
| `transpose` | int | `0` | Semitones. Range -24..24. |
| `vol` | num | `1.0` | Gain multiplier for this use. Range 0..4. |
| `layers` | list |  | Only these intensity layers play (default: all). |
| `mute` | list |  | Channels muted in this use. |
| `solo` | list |  | Only these channels play in this use. |
| `channels` | map |  | Per-channel overrides: {lead: {vol: 0.5, transpose: 12}}. |

## Loop semantics

- `loop: true` (default): the whole arrangement loops; tails and reverb wrap around circularly.
- `loop: {from: LABEL}`: sections before LABEL play once as an intro; the loop region starts at LABEL.
  Intro tails bleed into the loop start (that is how game engines will hear it too).
- `loop: false`: one-shot; the render keeps the natural tail and trims silence.
Loop points are written to the WAV `smpl` chunk, OGG `LOOPSTART`/`LOOPLENGTH` and the JSON sidecar.

## Chip profiles

| chip | description |
|---|---|
| `nes` | Nintendo 2A03: 2 pulse (4 duties), 32-step triangle, 15-bit LFSR noise (long/short), DPCM. |
| `gameboy` | Game Boy DMG: 2 pulse, 4-bit 32-sample wave channel, 7/15-bit noise. Hard left/centre/right panning only. |
| `sid` | Commodore 64 SID-style: 3 voices of pulse/saw/tri/noise with PWM, ring mod, hard sync and a resonant multimode filter. |
| `fm` | Genesis-style: 6 four-operator FM voices plus a PSG (3 pulse + noise). Basses, brass, bells, metallic hits. |
| `gm` | General-MIDI-style 16-bit palette: band-limited wavetables and FM, 16 voices, stereo. |
